plans.idea: Keep the original's structure in banner form: the headline, subheadline and availability line run as a left-aligned column, the 'Taste the Glow' pill sits right under it on the same left edge, and the bottle stands large on the right as the counterweight.
A three-column banner that reads left to right: the message on the left, the bottle in the centre as the visual anchor, and the CTA pill alone on the right as the clear endpoint.
The product leads: the bottle stands full height at the left edge, and a wide text field beside it keeps the headline big on one line, with the CTA pill aligned to the text's left edge underneath.
